# DANI DECLARES LLC — Provider Agreement

**DRAFT / ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED BEFORE THIS GOVERNS A REAL SIGNATURE**

This placeholder mirrors the existing convention in
`docs/templates/DANI_BUSINESS_BUILD_COMMERCIALIZATION_AGREEMENT_DRAFT.md`:
it is an operational starting point for the in-portal e-signature flow,
not a finished contract. Independent contractor classification, insurance
minimums per service type, indemnification, and dispute resolution are
jurisdiction- and fact-specific — replace this text with attorney-reviewed
language before treating a signature against it as binding.

## 1. Relationship

Signing this agreement does not create employment, partnership, or agency.
The signer ("Provider") is an independent contractor. DANI DECLARES LLC
("DANI") does not control the manner or means by which Provider performs
authorized work, only the result.

## 2. Scope of Authorization

Provider may only perform work DANI has expressly authorized for the
specific service(s)/SKU(s) reviewed and approved on Provider's application.
Signing this agreement does not itself authorize any service — authorization
requires DANI's separate, completed review of Provider's qualifications,
credentials, insurance, and compliance documentation for each service.

## 3. No Guarantee of Work

Network access is not a guarantee of work, a minimum number of jobs, or any
minimum income. DANI may decline to offer, or may withdraw, any assignment.

## 4. Compliance and Licensing

Provider is responsible for holding and maintaining any license, permit,
certification, or insurance legally required for the service(s) Provider is
authorized to perform, and for promptly notifying DANI if any such
requirement lapses. DANI may suspend or terminate authorization for a
service if compliance information expires or becomes insufficient.

## 5. Compensation

Provider is paid per completed, verified job according to the payout terms
DANI has established for the authorized service — DANI's governed pricing
and payout schedule control, not a rate Provider proposes.

## 6. Confidentiality

Provider will keep confidential any customer, property, financial, or
operational information encountered while performing DANI-dispatched work,
and will use it only to perform that work.

## 7. Termination

Either party may end this relationship at any time. Termination does not
affect payment already earned for completed, verified work, or Provider's
confidentiality obligations under Section 6.

## 8. No Warranty / Limitation

DANI makes no warranty regarding the volume, timing, or profitability of
any work offered under this agreement.

## 9. Governing Law

Governing law and venue are to be specified after attorney review based on
DANI's actual state of formation and primary operating jurisdiction.

## 10. Entire Agreement

This document, together with any signed service-specific schedule or
company-specific vendor paperwork Provider submits, is the entire agreement
between the parties regarding Provider's service to DANI unless a
separately signed writing says otherwise.

---

By typing your full legal name and submitting the signature form in the

be bound by the terms above as in effect on the date shown at signing.
